episodes.synopsis: When new robots known as Kilobots start appearing, Ikki and Metabee must prove why they finished second at the World Robattle Championships, but what will they do when the Medaforce doesn't work against these Kilobots?
episodes.title: Kilobot Rising

episodes.synopsis: When Ikki and Metabee promise not to robattle until Metabee's faulty parts are repaired, they discover it takes as much courage and skill to avoid a fight as it does to seek one out.
episodes.title: Fighting Temptation

episodes.synopsis: Ikki shows the mystery Medafighter how his obsession with destroying the kilobots makes him become similar to Kam, as they both treat their medabots as simple objects of destruction.
episodes.title: What the World Needs Now [a.k.a. Who is the Mystery Medafighter]

episodes.synopsis: Always help your folks. Chores can be fun and may lead to adventure!
episodes.title: Delivery Boy

episodes.synopsis: ERIKA must choose between her integrity and journalistic success when she competes with Kam and his kilobot, Fotoshoot, in â€˜best scoop' contest.
episodes.title: Scoop of the Century

episodes.synopsis: When Medabots and Kilobots start becoming zombies, it's up to Ikki and Metabee to save the day, but can Ikki overcome his fear of zombies to give Metabee strength?
episodes.title: Robbed Zombies

episodes.synopsis: Tak and Ikki learn that hard work and practice will always come before trickery and brute powerâ€¦especially in Robattling!
episodes.title: Lights, Camera... Robattle!

episodes.synopsis: In order to fufill his mission to destroy all Kilobots, MysteryMedafighter accepts the ultimate Kilobot from Kam. But is the cost too high?
episodes.title: Dark Alliance (1)

episodes.synopsis: Mystery Medafighter uses his near-invincible kilobot, Exor, to defeat Ikki, Metabee and anyone else who gets in his way. But does he have the heart to destroy his own medabot, Roks?
episodes.title: Dark Alliance (2)

episodes.synopsis: Metabee learns he can Medachange into Demolition Mode.  But will this be enough to stop the powerful Kilobot, Redrun, who is rampaging through the city?
episodes.title: Redrun-Away

episodes.synopsis: First impressions can be deceiving. Everyone deserves a second chance.
episodes.title: Erika's Secret Garden

episodes.synopsis: New Medabots are created to fight against the Kilobots, but when Metabee's original body is stolen choas begins.
episodes.title: Metabee's Out of Body Experience

episodes.synopsis: In order to keep his secret, Ginkai captures Honey, but before he can erase her memory, Metabee rescues her. Now who will rescue him...?
episodes.title: The Bee Rescues the Honey

episodes.synopsis: Ikki, Metabee, Totalizer and Sloan learn that friendship is more important than winning matches...it also lasts a lifetime.
episodes.title: A Night In The Medabot Junkyard

episodes.synopsis: Memories of his old medabot, Bayonet cause Ginkai to enter an official robattle tournament where he is forced to choose between his honour and his friendship with Kam.
episodes.title: Once A Medafighter (1)

episodes.synopsis: Ginkai rediscovers the friendship of his first Medabot, Bayonet, but will he put that friendship in jeopardy by answering Kam's challenge?
episodes.title: Once A Medafighter (2)

episodes.synopsis: When Kam's new Kilobot clasps on to Metabee it's a race to save him from the Kilobot's self destruction. Will they succeed?
episodes.title: Title Flight

episodes.synopsis: Forbidden to Robattle until he gets a good mark.  Ikki decides to cheat on his test... but things go from bad to worse when the plan backfires.
episodes.title: The Agony of the Cheat

episodes.synopsis: We learn through our mistakes...as Ikki does out on the soccer pitch...but we also realize that our friends will always be behind us...even after we mess up!
episodes.title: It's the Medafighter Way

episodes.synopsis: Kam lures Ikki and Metabee into a trap to ruin their honest reputation and promote the launch of his retail kilobot stores.
episodes.title: Fall from Grace (1)

episodes.synopsis: Erika, Zumi and Ginkai help prove Ikki and Metabee's innocence but will they survive Kam's latest trap?
episodes.title: Fall from Grace (2)

episodes.synopsis: Kam promises to terrorize the entire school until the Mystery Medafighter comes forward. Will Zuru reveal his secret identity?
episodes.title: Mystery Medafighter Unmasked?

episodes.synopsis: Embracing change is hard, but resisting it is harder.
episodes.title: The Truth About Charlie

episodes.synopsis: Banjo attacks Ikki and Metabee at Miss Nae's warehouse in an effort to flush out the Mystery Medafighter and destroy Tyrelbeetle.
episodes.title: Roks Reborn

episodes.synopsis: It's not what you've got... but what you do with it!
episodes.title: I, Kilobot

episodes.synopsis: Erika interviews her friends for an article in the Riverview Reader.  But will it be a glowing review or an expose?
episodes.title: Thanks for the Memories

episodes.synopsis: Spyke is so desperate to copy someone else's robattling style that he doesn't realize he has his own strategies hidden inside him the whole time.
episodes.title: How Spyke Got His Style Back

episodes.synopsis: Suzie challenges Erika to a grueling obstacle race known as the Straight Line Marathon.  But will the challenge prove too much for both of the competitors?
episodes.title: The Medabot Straight Line Marathon

episodes.synopsis: With a robattle against Ginkai looming, and no ammunition, will Ikki and Metabee come up with a solution?
episodes.title: Kung Fu For Thought

episodes.synopsis: Two of Kam's followers, Minitora and Kintora, ambush Ikki  and Erika at the amusement park.  Can Ikki and Erika stop arguing long enough to defeat these new rivals?
episodes.title: Erika to the Rescue

episodes.synopsis: If at first you DO succeed... sit the second one out.
episodes.title: Rough on a Hot Tin Cat

episodes.synopsis: Kam forces Blakbeetle to try summoning the Medaforce.  But how can she when it would be based on a friendship she doesn't have with Kam?
episodes.title: Meda-Forced

episodes.synopsis: Banjo challenges Ikki and Metabee to Robattle but can he be trusted to play by the rules and accept the true spirit of Medafighting?
episodes.title: Poor Miss Nae

episodes.synopsis: The best way to deal with a problem is to confront it head-on...Zuru won't get his father to come home for dinner by secretly destroying all the kilobots his Dad has ever built...
episodes.title: Mystery Medafighter...Revealed!

episodes.synopsis: Zuru finally reveals his identity as the Mystery Medafighter and challenges Kam and his followers to a robattle.
episodes.title: Winner Take All

episodes.synopsis: In order to have rivalry one must first have a rival!
episodes.title: Transfusion Confusion

episodes.synopsis: Kam inserts Blakbeetle's Neo-Evil Medal into Gryphon and begins Gryphon's weapons test.  Transformed into Gryphon, Blakbeetle experiences fear for the first time and runs away from Kam.  Kam anticipates her escape and has thus attached a transmitter to her body.  He orders his followers to find her.
episodes.title: Gryphoon Doom

episodes.synopsis: The kids attempt to rescue Blakbeetle from a horrible fate, but can they convince her to leave Kam?
episodes.title: Final Goodbyes

episodes.synopsis: Ikki and friends sneak into the research institute of the Evil Medabot Corporation to rescue Blakbeetle.  Kam says he will return Blakbeetle's medal to her if Ikki and his friends win a fight against Gryphon.
episodes.title: Into the Fire
